news.story: Castle was the story of the night, scoring a season-high 32 points. If his shots keep falling like this, the third-year guard could become a real problem for defenses already worried about Victor Wembanyama.

news.headline: Fox (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Utah.

news.story: Doncic got off to a blazing hot start Sunday, knocking down three three-pointers en route to 20 points in the first quarter.
